 BREAKING: Courtois out against Barcelona
 by Lucas Navarrete Oct 25, 2026, 10:21 AM UTC Facebook 
 Link 
 Real Madrid have announced that goalkeeper Thibaut Courtois will not play against FC Barcelona tonight.
 Per Realmadrid.com
 Courtois is a last-minute drop due to a flu process for tonight’s match between Real Madrid and Barcelona, corresponding to the tenth round of the League. Illia Voloshyn enters the squad list in his place. 
 This is devastating news for Real Madrid. Courtois is the world’s best goalkeeper and while Lunin has usually been reliable, Barcelona are an entirely different beast and he will need to play at a very high level if Los Blancos want to survive this one and avoid what would be a nine-point lead for Flick’s team.
